findings.failure_path: find() probes only the first occurrence of each marker, so a ccl checkout rooted under an ancestor named skills, hooks or scripts (e.g. ~/skills/ccl) is never recognised: shared markdown then skips the checkpoint entirely and source edits get the generic reason, silently losing the named extraction-owner replan this change exists to add
findings.smallest_fix: probe every occurrence of each marker (or walk the path's ancestors applying the marker-file plus first-component rule) before moving to the next marker

findings.failure_path: the '/.codex/' half of the cache exclusion is unpinned: every fixture and every applied mutant uses '/plugins/cache/' paths, so deleting just that disjunct keeps the suite green and marker-carrying plugin copies under a .codex tree without 'plugins/cache' would wrongly spend the checkpoint and print the owner reason
findings.smallest_fix: add a .codex-rooted cache fixture carrying the marker that asserts no checkpoint fires, or drop the disjunct if the stop backstop has no such scope

concern_results.conclusion: Decision table traces correctly through the diff: malformed patches return base before scope detection, the marker probe at the first skills//hooks//scripts/ component plus cache exclusions match the acceptance rows, .md counts only on the shared surface, and the loaded-owner branch keeps the generic reason; one defect found — text.find probes only the first occurrence of each marker, so a checkout rooted under an ancestor named skills/hooks/scripts is never recognised (P2 below)

No new write or mutation; the marker probe is a read-only stat on edit-derived paths, the deny stays one bounded replan whose text explicitly grants no new authority, and the reason echoes only the agent-supplied target path; no secret or personal-config reads added

Missing marker, cache paths and non-shared markdown all return base without spending the attempt; the false-negative direction degrades to prior behavior with the untouched Stop backstop still firing; empty/relative cwd falls back to the process cwd and is benign

Three new cases are RED on the prior hook and the fourth pins the loaded-owner generic reason; four applied mutants fail only their owning cases, and the attempt-not-spent precision row is asserted; gaps: no fixture or mutant pins the '/.codex/' exclusion disjunct, and no case covers a checkout under an ancestor named skills/hooks/scripts

Non-ccl repositories see byte-identical decisions (marker absent reduces to the old suffix rule); ccl-skills shared markdown now spends the single checkpoint by declared design; denial count per actor/context unchanged; no state-format or transcript-schema change

Plugin-shipped hook with revert of the single hook commit restoring the prior checkpoint; the stop backstop and CI layers are untouched; no migration, and e2 shows make test, heavy-only, sanitization and diff --check all exit 0

The deny reason names the first shared target path and the owning skill at the moment of the edit; the reference records the observed miss, the firing point and its limits (Bash-written edits, once per context, no charter proof)

Register and reference claims (three RED cases, four mutants, late plan disclosure, partial enforcement) match e1/e2 and the diff; the docstring's same-scope-as-the-stop-backstop equivalence is asserted but the backstop hook is outside the bounded packet — the observable behaviors themselves are test-pinned
